title: Technical Guidelines: Applications for DGIR approval under s.44(6) ITA 1967 for Houses of Worship Management Funds (Tabung Pengurusan Rumah Ibadat)
summary: HASiL issued updated guidelines on how a house of worship management fund applies for approval under s.44(6) ITA 1967, so that donations to it are tax-deductible. They cover eligibility criteria and conditions, the application procedure, amendments to the fund's rules, the effect of breaching approval conditions, and the approval period and extensions. Now listed under Legislation > Guidelines; CTIM has also circulated it.
replaces: Replaces the Guidelines on Applications for DGIR Approval under s.44(6) ITA 1967 for Houses of Worship Management Funds issued on 15/07/2020
